# Azerbaijani Spelling Check Skill

This skill provides tools for checking and correcting spelling in Azerbaijani language text within the workspace.

## Features

- Detect common Azerbaijani spelling errors
- Suggest corrections for proper use of special characters (ə, ö, ü, ş, ç, ğ)
- Validate text in HTML files and other documents
- Provide automated fixes for identified issues

## Usage

Use this skill when you need to:
- Check spelling in Azerbaijani text
- Correct common misspellings
- Ensure proper Azerbaijani orthography
- Validate content before publishing

## Implementation

The skill uses pattern matching and basic rules to identify potential spelling issues. For advanced spell checking, it may integrate with external services or dictionaries.

## Examples

- Correct "Derinlik" to "Dərinlik"
- Fix missing special characters in words
- Validate proper Azerbaijani grammar patterns
